Toronto Dominion Bank Has Lifted Oracle (ORCL) Stake by $10.40 Million; Share Price Declined; Twin Tree Management LP Has Decreased Position in China Mobile Limited (CHL) by $4.46 Million 
April 18, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade 
Twin Tree Management Lp decreased its stake in China Mobile Limited (CHL) by 87.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Twin Tree Management Lp sold 89,251 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.06% with the market. The hedge fund held 12,749 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $644,000, down from 102,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Twin Tree Management Lp who had been investing in China Mobile Limited for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $190.80B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.53% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $46.63. About 1.00M shares traded or 0.22% up from the average. China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) has declined 14.69% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.24% the S&P500. 
Toronto Dominion Bank increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 17.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Toronto Dominion Bank bought 221,197 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.18% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.51 million shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $71.60M, up from 1.29M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Toronto Dominion Bank who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $190.48 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.32% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $46.66. About 10.76M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 1.20% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.35% the S&P500. 
Toronto Dominion Bank, which manages about $33.76 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Open Text Corp (Put) (NASDAQ:OTEX) by 35,400 shares to 4,700 shares, valued at $168,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Oracle Corp (Put) (NYSE:ORCL) by 1.11 million shares in the quarter, leaving it with 183,100 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (Put) (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 42 analysts covering Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), 27 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Oracle had 115 analyst reports since July 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Wednesday, March 16 by Goldman Sachs. The rating was upgraded by JMP Securities to “Market Perform” on Thursday, March 16. BMO Capital Markets maintained it with “Buy” rating and $57.0 target in Wednesday, August 16 report. Wedbush upgraded Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) on Thursday, June 22 to “Outperform” rating. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Barclays Capital given on Friday, September 15. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of ORCL in report on Friday, August 25 with “Buy” rating. As per Wednesday, September 16, the company rating was upgraded by SunTrust. The rating was initiated by BMO Capital Markets on Friday, January 8 with “Market Perform”. Benchmark maintained Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) on Friday, April 28 with “Buy” rating. The rating was initiated by BTIG Research on Thursday, September 10 with “Buy”. 
Investors sentiment increased to 1.15 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.02, from 1.13 in 2017Q3. It improved, as 80 investors sold ORCL shares while 488 reduced holdings. 126 funds opened positions while 526 raised stakes. 2.29 billion shares or 1.37% less from 2.32 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft Fi owns 0.25% invested in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) for 421,821 shares. Mark Sheptoff Fincl Planning Llc has 0.21% invested in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Marshwinds Advisory reported 107,631 shares. Cetera Advisors Llc has invested 0.09% of its portfolio in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Optimum Advsr holds 0.47% of its portfolio in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) for 31,130 shares. Ascend Capital Limited Liability Corp has invested 0.31% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Meridian Counsel holds 0.63% or 24,119 shares. Vestor Capital Limited Com holds 46,340 shares or 0.47% of its portfolio. Mercer Capital Advisers stated it has 0.02% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Cubic Asset Mngmt Ltd Liability Corp invested 0.24% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Amundi Pioneer Asset Mgmt holds 0.41% or 5.58M shares. Citizens And Northern has invested 1.44% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). National Bank Of The Ozarks reported 41,593 shares. Tctc Ltd Liability, a Texas-based fund reported 6,332 shares. Cedar Hill Assoc Ltd Com has 4,972 shares for 0.04% of their portfolio.
